div.div: Commented on #60 codecov is not updating
Created new branch codecov/5.4.1 in FCP-INDI/C-PAC
Commented on #2232 🐛Fix bbreg issue with oblique datasets

In our defense, I don't think we tell/show the user that we were calling it "deoblique" and it was just simply the data "initialization" step. Yeah, I think the only places a user would likely see it are in the node names in the logs, and in the descriptions for the old output format: anatomical_reorient: Deobliqued, reoriented whole-head anatomical scan. No other pre-processing yet.

div.div: Pytests: getting error function uses no argument error
singularity run error: No valid /bin/sh in container
For me this suggestion did the trick: when changing Singularity versions, configuration, or installation path, run make clean between make and make install in the installation process.
